description: This file contains comprehensive unit tests and integration tests for the SlackAlerting component of the litellm project. It tests various functionalities including alerting mechanisms for slow responses, budget crossings, outage detection, and webhook alerts, ensuring the robustness and correctness of the alerting system in different scenarios.

classes.name: AlertType
classes.description: Enumeration of different alert types used within the SlackAlerting system to categorize alert messages.

classes.name: SlackAlerting
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing and triggering alerts based on various conditions such as slow responses, budget thresholds, and outages.

classes.name: CallInfo
classes.description: Data class representing user or entity-specific information used in budget and alerting logic.

classes.name: WebhookEvent
classes.description: Data class representing the payload structure sent via webhook in alert notifications.
